{{otheruses|the [[explorable area]]|the [[stories|story]]|Sorrow's Furnace (story)}} {{Location infobox | name = Sorrow's Furnace | image = [[File:Guild Wars Screenshot 076.jpg|250px]] | campaign = Prophecies | region = Southern Shiverpeaks | type = Explorable area | exits = [[Grenth's Footprint]] | collector = y | ingame name=Sorrow's Furnace | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=190 | pic1 = [[File:Sorrow's Furnace map.jpg|250px|link=Sorrow's Furnace/Map]] | pic1-text = Interactive map | pic2 = [[File:Sorrow's Furnace route.jpg|250px]] | pic2-text = Getting there from [[Deldrimor War Camp]] | pic3 = [[File:Sorrow's Furnace collectors map.jpg|250px]] | pic3-text = Collector map }} [[Sorrow's Furnace]] is the largest mine of the [[Stone Summit]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]], resting at the base of [[Grenth's Footprint]]. The land surrounding Sorrow's Furnace was once sacred for the [[Deldrimor]] Dwarves until it was stripped by the Stone Summit for the metals in the mountain, and turned into a series of mines with Sorrow's Furnace at the base. Within Sorrow's Furnace itself is a series of underground mining operations as well as a multitude of ruins. Within the northern portions of Sorrow's Furnace, a huge crevice opens into the surface in the area known as [[The Gap]], allowing the cold mountain air and snow to meet with the burning heat of the furnaces. In the southern portions lie a series of tunnels covered in vegetation, not yet mined and littered with the old ruins - including [[The Stone Basilica]]. In the heart of the furnace lies the [[Iron Forgeman]], a large cyclopean golem being constructed to both replace the need of the Stone Summit's [[Dredge Slave]]s as well as become a weapon to use in the war against Deldrimor. ==Getting there== Exit [[Deldrimor War Camp]] into Grenth's Footprint and head downwards into the Stone Summit. Make your way north from there, being careful of the various bosses that [[spawn]]. The entrance into Sorrow's Furnace isn't far in, and should become visible on your radar soon after going north. ==Quests available== [[To Sorrow's Furnace]] serves as an overarching quest for the Sorrow's Furnace quests, leading up to [[The Final Assault]] and [[The Forge Heart]]. * [[Ennis Granitestrider]] ** [[The Forge Heart]] (only when [[The Final Assault]] is active or completed) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} * [[Galen Trask]] ** [[Summit Slaves]] (only when [[To Sorrow's Furnace]] is active or completed) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} * [[High Priest Alkar]] ** [[Unspeakable, Unknowable]] (only when [[To Sorrow's Furnace]] is active or completed) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} * [[Kilroy Stonekin]] ** [[Kilroy Stonekin (quest)|Kilroy Stonekin]] (only when [[To Sorrow's Furnace]] is active or completed) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} * [[Krak Flamewhip]] ** [[Cold One]] (only when [[Summit Slaves]] is active) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} ** [[Fire in the Hole]] (only when [[Summit Slaves]] is active) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} ** [[Gathering Resources]] (only when [[Summit Slaves]] is active) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} ** [[Unruly Slaves]] (only when [[Summit Slaves]] is active) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} ** [[Wrenches In The Gears]] (only when [[Summit Slaves]] is active) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} * [[Marshall Whitman]] ** [[Tasca's Reprise]] {{quest icon|Repeatable}} * [[Molachev]] ** [[Subversive Ideas]] {{quest icon|Repeatable}} * [[Orozar Highstone]] ** [[Noble Intentions]] (only when [[To Sorrow's Furnace]] is active or completed) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} ** [[Noble Intentions Plan B]] (only when [[To Sorrow's Furnace]] is active or completed, after completion of [[Noble Intentions]]) {{quest icon|Repeatable}} * [[Tharn Stonerift]] ** [[Political Ramifications]] {{quest icon|Repeatable}} ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 24 (?)
